landing_meta_title: Přejeme si – gifts you want, still a surprise
landing_meta_description: Share your wishes with one link. Family and friends can reserve gifts so you do not receive the same gift twice.
landing_og_title: Přejeme si – gifts you want, still a surprise
landing_og_description: Family and friends coordinate reservations. You stay surprised.
landing_badge_occasions: Christmas, birthdays or an ongoing list
landing_hero_title: Gifts you want. Still a surprise.
landing_hero_description: Share your wishes with one link. Family and friends can reserve gifts so you do not receive the same gift twice. You never see whether a gift is reserved or who is getting it for you.
landing_privacy_note: Tereza cannot see reservations. Family and friends can.
landing_demo_headline: Friends see the reservation. Petra doesn't.
landing_demo_intro: This is Petra's birthday wishlist. Reserve a gift for her and watch what she gets to see — nothing.
landing_demo_pair_caption: The same wish through different eyes. A “Reserved” sticker on the left, no trace of it on the right.
landing_demo_gifter_hint: Reserve a gift and everyone else instantly knows it is taken.
landing_demo_recipient_hint: Petra only sees her wishes. No reservations, no names.
landing_demo_like_popup: The counter is real — other visitors move it too. In the app you also get an e-mail when someone reserves a gift you liked.
landing_demo_invariant_caption: Petra cannot see it is reserved — the surprise holds.
landing_demo_wishlist_description: We are meeting in our garden — presents are optional, but very welcome.
landing_demo_gift_teapot_description: For morning tea, something that keeps it warm.
landing_demo_gift_headphones_description: For the train and for running, white is fine.
landing_demo_gift_book_description: Before another monstera dies on me.
landing_demo_gift_candle_description: Fig or vanilla ideally, for reading in the evening.
landing_demo_gift_backpack_description: About twenty litres, room for snacks and a raincoat.
landing_demo_gift_watercolours_descripti: I finally want to learn to paint landscapes.
landing_how_step1_description: Name it, pick a color and add a date if you want.
landing_how_step2_description: Paste a shop link or add a short description with a price.
landing_how_step3_description: Send it to family and friends through WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram or email.
landing_how_step4_description: Family and friends see what is already reserved. You still see only your wishes.
landing_feat1_description: Family and friends see what is already reserved. Your view stays clean.
landing_feat2_description: Send one link. Family and friends enter a name, reserve a gift and everyone else sees it.
landing_feat3_description: Christmas, birthdays, weddings or an ongoing list. Each list can have its own mood.
landing_cta_title: Start a list — for a celebration, or just because.
landing_cta_description: A few wishes and one link are enough. Přejeme si keeps gifts from repeating.
landing_footer_author: A personal open-source project by Martin P. for gifts that do not repeat.
